explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/52 (the Erdős–Szemerédi sum-product conjecture): for finite A ⊆ ℤ, is max(|A+A|, |AA|) ≫_ε |A|^{2-ε} for every ε > 0? The statement asserts, for each ε ∈ (0,1), some C > 0 with max ≥ C|A|^{2-ε} for all finite A ⊆ ℤ. Restricting to ε < 1 loses nothing, since larger ε is weaker, and the empty set satisfies the bound trivially. Faithful.
